title: Voltmeter reading
description: Essential Criteria: The student must correctly calculate the voltmeter reading as 40 V, accounting for voltage division across the external circuit.

title: Charge calculation
description: Essential Criteria: The student must correctly calculate the charge passing through the coil as 0.5 C when rotating 30° from the initial position.

title: Joule heat per revolution
description: Essential Criteria: The student must correctly calculate the Joule heat generated in one revolution as 120π√2 J.

title: Maximum EMF derivation
description: Important Criteria: The student must correctly apply Faraday's law to derive the maximum EMF (Em = NBL²ω).

title: Circuit resistance analysis
description: Important Criteria: The student must correctly determine the equivalent external resistance (6 Ω) by analyzing series and parallel combinations.

title: Average EMF for charge
description: Important Criteria: The student must use the average EMF (ΔΦ/Δt) rather than instantaneous values when calculating the charge transferred.

title: RMS voltage conversion
description: Optional Criteria: The student should correctly convert between maximum and RMS values for sinusoidal AC quantities.

title: Flux change calculation
description: Optional Criteria: The student may show the correct calculation of magnetic flux change (ΔΦ = BL²sin30°).

title: Incorrect RMS application
description: Pitfall Criteria: Penalize if the student incorrectly uses RMS values instead of average EMF when calculating charge.

title: Resistance omission error
description: Pitfall Criteria: Penalize if the student omits the coil's internal resistance (r) in circuit calculations.
